subject: mathjax or HTML entities in labels

messages.author: e28c6f16c9d07e24
messages.subject: mathjax or HTML entities in labels
parts:
I'm looking for an easy way to include symbols in labels. I currently have:

      sliderInput("mu", "Mean (μ):", 0, min=-2, max=2,step=.01),

but it is converting the ampersand to & (which is intended, I'm sure). I tried this:

      sliderInput("mu", HTML("Mean (μ):"), 0, min=-2, max=2,step=.01),

but that didn't do anything (& still gets converted to &). I'd really like to include mathjax, actually, but I saw this: https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/issues/22 and couldn't figure out where to put the suggested code.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: mathjax or HTML entities in labels
parts: That looks like a bug in sliderInput--your second line should work. In the meantime I *believe* that if you put a literal μ there and make sure ui.R is saved using UTF-8 encoding it should work.
